jobs.title: タイトル
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Input image1 is the EDIT TARGET, a previously generated and selected B / 2D Toon Bold mobile game screen. Create ONE precise color-palette variant. Preserve exact portrait canvas, layout, every object's size and position, flat front-facing 5-column x 4-row square grid where present, all gaps, round-cornered tile outlines, heavy ink-navy keylines, broad rounded typography, hard offset shadows, cream surfaces, sky-blue background and cloud silhouettes. Do not redesign or invent new content.
The TARGET GAMEPLAY PALETTE is RED (#FF3E43) + YELLOW (#FFD42A) = ORANGE (#FF8C28).
ROLE MAPPING from the original gameplay colors: original CORAL RED game role -> RED; original COBALT BLUE game role -> YELLOW; original VIOLET PURPLE mixed game role -> ORANGE. Apply mapping consistently to game start dots, tile TARGET SQUARE borders, colored tile faces, route strokes, mixed overlaps, game mixing motif, color legend swatches, reset-color buttons, and color-selection options.
Crucial semantic recolor: DO NOT recolor the sky-blue/cyan background, blue cloud shading, blue HOME button, blue primary CTA button, navy outlines/text or blue decorative shadows into yellow. Those are stable UI colors. Only BLUE used for a playable color becomes YELLOW.
Use lighter tints of target colors for filled tile faces, darker saturated versions for lines so they remain readable. Navy plus/equals symbols remain navy. YELLOW reset arrows and YELLOW option lettering should be DARK NAVY for readable contrast; saturated RED reset arrows/options can retain white. Yellow is rich sunny golden yellow, not cream or pastel off-white.
No phone/device frame, collage, annotations, watermark, invented game mechanics or extra buttons. This is a single full-bleed screen.

TITLE SCREEN: keep the COLOR TRACE logo lettering and shape, cream sticker border, tagline "TRACE & MIX", same three-tile mixing illustration and exactly one large BLUE primary play button. Recolor only the game's colored COLOR letters into a balanced RED/YELLOW/ORANGE palette (no leftover purple), while TRACE remains white/navy. Illustration left origin and left route become RED; right origin and right route become YELLOW; shared lower-center route/endpoint becomes ORANGE. The THREE decorative tile interiors remain WHITE. The play triangle stays WHITE; button itself stays BLUE. Change the button label from "STAGE 3" to "STAGE 6". Do not add a mixing equation or gameplay grid to the title. ONLY text: "COLOR", "TRACE", "TRACE & MIX", "STAGE 6".
